summary: Confirmed DONE. At f1be4abc7, Diffs.ts imported the @pierre/diffs root, which loaded shiki and the highlighting stack at boot. #710 (60633eff3) switched Diffs.ts to the dependency-free '@pierre/diffs/utils/parsePatchFiles' subpath. 37772e074 then always-bundles @pierre/diffs, because that subpath exists only through the repo patch. The current dist's cliMain boot closure is 49 chunks and 6.61 MB. Its externals are node: builtins only: no @pierre, shiki, @shikijs, oniguruma or hast-util. The only inlined pierre code is six small parser regions. Diffs.ts is the only server import of the package, and the Hub has no server-side @pierre use. The source guard rejects a root import on the serve path. A side note: the dist-level @pierre assertions cannot catch a root import, because alwaysBundle inlines it. The 7 MB byte budget (about 388 KB of headroom) and the source guard cover that case, so this is not a real gap.

evidence.note: Now `import { parsePatchFiles } from "@pierre/diffs/utils/parsePatchFiles"`. At f1be4abc7 it was `from "@pierre/diffs"` (git show). git grep finds no other @pierre/diffs import in apps/server/src or packages/*.
Imports only ../constants.js and five ./utils helpers. None of these import anything, so the parser is a 7-module, dependency-free closure.

alwaysBundle includes isBundledPatchedPackageImport, which covers ['@pierre/diffs'] (scripts/patchedPackages.ts:16). This keeps the published ryco-cli working without the repo patch, which adds the exports at patches/@pierre%2Fdiffs@1.4.1.patch.

Built today. The only @pierre regions are getHunkSideBoundaries, composeCacheKey, cleanLastNewline, detachString, realignChangeContent and parsePatchFiles. No dist .mjs file mentions shiki, @shikijs, oniguruma or hast-util, and none has an @pierre import specifier. The static boot closure (49 chunks, 6,611,615 bytes) has only node: builtins as externals.

The source guard requires the cliMain static graph, which follows workspace packages, to have no external '@pierre/diffs'. A root import anywhere on the serve path, including a workspace package, fails this test. This is the 'ban the root import' guard the finding proposed.

The dist assertions ban any '@pierre/diffs*' external. Because alwaysBundle inlines any @pierre/diffs specifier, they can only catch the package being dropped from BUNDLED_PATCHED_PACKAGES, not a root import, despite the test title.

The boot-closure byte budget (under 7,000,000) stands in for the proposed module-count guard. Current size is 6.61 MB, about 388 KB of headroom. An inlined pierre root plus shiki core would almost certainly exceed it.
The publish smoke test installs the packed CLI and runs `serve`, so a regression to an unbundled patch-only export would fail before npm publish.

fixDefects: No functional defects. One minor guard-precision note: the built-dist checks at apps/server/src/serverBundleBoundaries.test.ts:224 and :227 cannot detect a root import in the bundle. alwaysBundle (tsdown.config.ts:46 via patchedPackages.ts:16) inlines '@pierre/diffs', so it never appears as an external specifier. Root-import protection therefore rests on the source guard (:146) and the 7 MB budget (:253). Both are adequate.
implementationSketch: Nothing is required. Optional hardening (low worth): in the 'keeps the boot chunks within budget' loop at serverBundleBoundaries.test.ts:254-260, add `expect(source).not.toMatch(/^\/\/#region .*@pierre\/diffs\/dist\/(?!utils\/(?:parsePatchFiles|getHunkSideBoundaries|composeCacheKey|cleanLastNewline|detachString|realignChangeContent)\.js$)/mu)` plus a ban on `^//#region .*node_modules/.*/(?:shiki|@shikijs)/` region markers. This makes the dist guard catch an inlined root import directly instead of relying on the byte budget. Separate and unrelated to boot: @pierre/diffs is still a declared runtime dependency in apps/server/package.json:38, even though it is fully bundled. npm installs of ryco-cli therefore still download shiki and @shikijs/*. Moving it to devDependencies, which scripts/cli.ts strips at publish, would trim install size. Check the published package with package-smoke.
decisionReason: Server-local bundling and import change. It touches no auth, E2EE, Hub protocol or hosted lifecycle code.
correction: The auditor listed the built-dist '@pierre/diffs*' assertions as guards related to the root-import ban. With alwaysBundle in place they cannot fail for a root import, so they only guard against the package being unbundled. Root-import protection comes from the source guard and the byte budget. This does not change the DONE classification.
